A field guide to an inhabited world · volume III · the cat family

Nekomata

Six big-cat monster girls who share one rule: a cat chooses you, never the other way round. Serval, tiger, lioness, snow leopard, cheetah and lynx: different hunting grounds, the same proud, sleepy, curious heart. Live with one long enough and she may wake one morning with a second tail.

I · HarpiesII · Bullywugs & Mucus ToadsIII · NekomataIV · KitsuneV · LamiaVI · ArachneVII · CentaursVIII · MerfolkIX · SlimesX · JackalopesXI · MinotaursXII · MollusksXIII · ElvesXIV · UndeadXV · LizardfolkXVI · DragonsXVII · DevilsXVIII · BugsXIX · Flora
The central similarity

A cat chooses you.

Harpies are defined by the sky and anurans by water. Cats are defined by independence. Chasing a nekomata makes her leave; ignoring her makes her curious. Everything about bonding with this family turns on patience, and on the moments when she decides to come to you.

  • Patience is the bond actionSneak (crouch) or stand still near her and she approaches and headbutts you. Running at her sets you back.
  • Petting has limitsEach cat tolerates a few strokes, then swats (no damage at high friendship). Her tolerance grows with affection.
  • Hunters at heartA wild cat sees a stranger as prey: she creeps up low and pounces, until you give her meat. Then the patience game begins.
  • Two tailsOne wild cat in ten is born a nekomata with a split tail; any devoted cat who has lived with you for ten days becomes one (second tail, pale spirit-fire, a spare life).

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a nekomata builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Patience: sneak or stand still within a few blocks and let her come to you (+1, once a minute)
  • Fish of any kind, raw chicken, rabbit, milk (a bucket she laps from)
  • Petting within her tolerance
  • A sunny, warm spot of your own (wool or a bed) that she adopts as her nap spot

What costs trust

  • Sprinting at her or chasing her
  • Petting past her tolerance (she swats, -1)
  • Getting her wet with a water bucket
  • Hitting her (a grudge; she avoids you for days)

Devoted (60+)

Ten days after reaching full devotion she becomes a true nekomata: her second tail grows in, pale blue spirit-fire flickers around her at night, and once every five days a killing blow leaves her at half health instead (her spare life).

Mating & young

FormLive litter in a den. YoungKittens (2-3), grown in 5 days. WhereA roofed, dark nook within 16 blocks of her nap spot. The kittens use the adult model at 45% scale with an oversized head bone.

1. CourtshipOnly at high friendship (25+). On a night you sleep in your own bed she may curl up in it beside you. One full night is enough: she is expecting by morning, and her belly rounds out over the day.
2. The denWhen her time comes she looks for a quiet, roofed, dark corner within 16 blocks of where she sleeps (under leaves, beneath stairs, in a barn) and makes a den there out of anything soft: wool, hay, leaves.
3. The litterTwo or three kittens are born in the den, each of her species in a random colour of it. Kittens play-fight, tumble and wander. When one strays too far, she carries it back by the scruff.
4. GrownKittens grow up in five days. Each one is devoted to the player who fathered the litter (full affection), treats that player as family and never shares their bed.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

Sunbeams & napsCats sleep most of the day, on warm blocks in sunlight: wool, carpets, beds, the top of a lit furnace or smoker. A sleeping cat ignores everything but a hand or a threat. Lionesses nap even more than the rest.
Stalk & pounceShe creeps up on chickens, rabbits, fish in shallow water and silverfish, with her body low and her tail twitching, then pounces. A miss leaves her embarrassed: she sits down and grooms as if nothing happened.
PresentsAt high friendship she leaves gifts by your bed or door: feathers, rabbit hide, string, raw rabbit or chicken, the occasional phantom membrane. It is the cat version of the harpies' gifts.
Guardian purrCreepers keep their distance from a nekomata, and phantoms will not dive at a player who has one close by (the vanilla cat rules). A cat purring on your bed gives you Regeneration I when you wake.
Knocking things overCurious paws bat at dropped items, push them off ledges and into water, and knock over flower pots. Harmless, endlessly annoying.
Hates getting wetRain sends most of them under cover, and they never swim willingly. The exception is the tiger, who loves water and fishes.

Species profiles

Savanna & tall grassCurious · bouncy

Serval (about 1.75 blocks)

TemperamentCurious, chatty, easily excited

Ecology & behaviourHunts by sound in tall grass, swivelling her huge ears, then springs high into the air to come down on her prey. Chirps and mews instead of roaring.

Signature: Sky pounce & ear scanLeaps three blocks up to catch birds and bats in mid-air. A bonded serval hears what you cannot: she hisses and flattens her ears towards the nearest hostile mob within 24 blocks, even through stone.

Player interactionSit quietly in tall grass at dusk and let her find you. Offer chicken or fish.

Colour variants

Savanna gold (default) · Golden coat with bold black spots and stripesServaline · Fine freckled spots, a paler goldMelanistic · Black on black, spots only in sunlightDesert pale · Sandy cream with faded spotsKing · Spots merged into long blotched stripes

Spawns insavanna, savanna_plateau

DangerLow; a swat at worst.

Jungle, bamboo & taiga riversSolitary · powerful

Tiger (about 2.05 blocks)

TemperamentCalm, solitary, supremely confident

Ecology & behaviourThe largest cat. Patrols a wide territory, hides in bamboo and tall grass, swims rivers without a second thought and fishes with her paws. Her roar sends hostile mobs running.

Signature: Ambush, fishing & roarCrouched in bamboo or tall grass she is nearly invisible until she pounces (a strong opening strike). She catches fish in rivers and brings them to her favourites. Her roar makes hostile mobs within 12 blocks flee for a few seconds.

Player interactionLeave raw meat at the water's edge and back off. Never corner her.

Colour variants

Bengal (default) · Deep orange, black stripes, white bellySiberian · Pale amber, thinner stripes, a thick winter ruffWhite · White coat, chocolate stripes, blue eyesGolden tabby · Strawberry gold with soft red-brown stripesBlack-striped · Stripes so wide they merge across the back

Spawns injungle, bamboo_jungle, sparse_jungle, taiga, old_growth_spruce_taiga

DangerHigh if provoked; otherwise she ignores you.

SavannaSocial · lazy

Lioness (about 1.95 blocks)

TemperamentRelaxed, loyal to her pride, ferocious in a hunt

Ecology & behaviourThe only social cat: lionesses live in prides of three to five sisters, nap through the heat of the day under acacias and hunt together at dusk, surrounding a cow or horse before they spring.

Signature: PrideA bonded lioness treats you as part of her pride: when you attack something, every lioness of her pride within 24 blocks joins in, and when you are hurt they come running.

Player interactionMeet the pride at midday when they are sleepy. Bring enough meat for all of them.

Colour variants

Tawny (default) · Warm tawny gold, cream belly, black ear backsDesert · Pale sand with a white muzzleWhite · Cream-white, pale blue eyesCave · Grey-brown with faint stripes (an Ice Age lioness)Atlas · Dark russet with a darker back

Spawns insavanna, savanna_plateau, windswept_savanna

DangerModerate: one is calm, a pride is not.

Snowy slopes & peaksShy · acrobatic

Snow Leopard (about 1.8 blocks)

TemperamentShy, gentle, a ghost of the mountains

Ecology & behaviourLives on the highest cliffs, leaps between ledges and across chasms, and wraps her enormous fluffy tail around herself (and her favourites) against the cold.

Signature: Cliff leaps & warm tailShe jumps across gaps up to six blocks and never takes fall damage. A bonded snow leopard near you stops you freezing in powder snow; asleep beside you she wraps you in her tail (no freezing, Resistance I when you wake).

Player interactionClimb to her. Leave meat on a ledge she can reach and you cannot easily.

Colour variants

Snow grey (default) · Smoky grey-white with open charcoal rosettesCream · Warm cream with brown rosettesSmoky · Dark smoke grey with black rosettesSilver · Almost white with faint rosettesGolden · Pale gold with grey rosettes

Spawns insnowy_slopes, jagged_peaks, frozen_peaks, grove, stony_peaks

DangerLow; she would rather vanish.

Savanna & badlandsGentle · fast

Cheetah (about 1.85 blocks)

TemperamentGentle, nervous, sweet

Ecology & behaviourThe fastest runner in the world, in short bursts: she sprints at double speed for five seconds and then has to rest, panting. Hunts rabbits in the open, chirps like a bird, and cannot roar or climb.

Signature: Sprint bursts & pace-setterFive-second bursts at double speed (then a rest). Sprint alongside a bonded cheetah and she paces you: you get Speed II while she runs. She hunts rabbits for you and drops them at your feet.

Player interactionRace her. Cheetahs were hunting companions for people long ago, and she warms to anyone who runs with her.

Colour variants

Classic (default) · Golden with solid round spots and black tear marksKing · Spots merged into stripes along the backWoolly · Pale, long-haired, faint spotsDesert · Pale sand, small spotsRed · Strawberry gold with red-brown spots

Spawns insavanna, savanna_plateau, badlands, wooded_badlands

DangerLow; she would rather run.

Taiga & snowy forestElusive · patient

Lynx (about 1.7 blocks)

TemperamentElusive, patient, quietly affectionate

Ecology & behaviourTufted ears, a short bobbed tail and huge furry paws that work like snowshoes. She hunts rabbits almost exclusively and is gone the moment she knows she is seen.

Signature: Snowshoe paws & rabbit hunterShe never sinks into powder snow and moves at full speed on snow. She keeps rabbits away from your crops and brings you rabbit hide and rabbit's feet. Watched for too long, she slips out of sight (she breaks line of sight and hides).

Player interactionLeave rabbit meat in snowy forest and look away. When you look back she may be eating it.

Spawns intaiga, snowy_taiga, old_growth_pine_taiga, snowy_plains, grove

DangerLow.

Jungle & bambooNocturnal · climber

Ocelot (about 1.65 blocks)

TemperamentSecretive, nocturnal, fiercely private

Ecology & behaviourLeopardus pardalis (Felidae). A small spotted cat of the jungle floor who hunts at dusk and dawn and climbs well. She is cousin to the vanilla ocelots and just as shy.

Signature: Tree climberShe climbs straight up tree trunks and walls like the gray fox and spends the day high in the canopy. Her presents are jungle finds: cocoa beans, feathers, the odd melon slice.

Player interactionCome at dusk, sneak, and bring fish. Never chase her into the trees.

Colour variants

Spawns injungle, sparse_jungle, bamboo_jungle

DangerLow.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Petting tolerance and swats
  • Warm-spot naps by day
  • Hunting rabbits, silverfish, and chickens while wild
  • Presents by species
  • Creepers avoid her
  • Bed perk: Regeneration (snow leopard: also Resistance)
  • True nekomata after ten devoted days: second tail, spirit fire, a spare life every five days
  • Litter of 2-3 kittens in the darkest roofed nook nearby; kittens follow their mother
  • Serval ear scan, tiger roar and fishing presents, lioness pride, snow leopard warm tail and no fall damage, cheetah bursts and pace-setting, lynx snowshoes and hiding
  • Wild cats attack strangers until fed meat once; more meat builds friendship
  • Stalking: a low creep after her chosen prey before the pounce
  • One wild cat in ten is born a nekomata with a split tail

Not yet

  • Knocking items off ledges
  • Phantoms avoiding her player
  • Carrying a straying kitten back by the scruff
  • Building a den out of wool or hay
  • Tiger near-invisibility in tall grass

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • Lion swapped for the lioness (no mane): the brief keeps the families female.
  • The black panther is not a species here; the melanistic serval and black-striped tiger cover it as colours.
  • Kittens use the adult model at a small scale with a bigger head, so 6 species need no extra models.
  • The second tail is a hidden bone (tail_2) that the renderer shows for true nekomata.

Open questions

  • Should a true nekomata's spare life also work for her player (a once-a-week totem)?
  • Should kittens be catchable in a lead, like vanilla pets?
